en.title: Nusantara Jok (Auto-Stitch OS)
en.short_desc: Comprehensive business management system with Kanban, smart calculator, and dynamic pricing engine.
en.full_desc: Nusantara Jok is an end-to-end order management system featuring a Kanban board for work order tracking, automated database partitioning, and a robust CRUD-enabled pricelist management system.

id.title: Nusantara Jok (Auto-Stitch OS)
id.short_desc: Sistem manajemen bisnis komprehensif dengan Kanban, kalkulator pintar, dan mesin harga dinamis.
id.full_desc: Nusantara Jok adalah sistem manajemen pesanan end-to-end yang menampilkan papan Kanban untuk pelacakan perintah kerja, partisi basis data otomatis, dan sistem manajemen daftar harga CRUD yang kuat.

en.title: Lexilink (Mobile App)
en.short_desc: Real-time Android competitive vocabulary game with low-latency synchronization.
en.full_desc: Lexilink is a high-performance Android game using Kotlin and Jetpack Compose. It implements a sub-100ms real-time synchronization system via Firebase and a hybrid validation loop.
